# Disagreement Log — GTH_075

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 75
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 75 | "standing at the door" | "standing at the door" | "waiting at the door" | *aheratou*: standing (static) vs. waiting (anticipatory) |
| 2 | 75 | "the solitary ones" | "the solitary" | "those who are truly alone" | *monachos*: nominal vs. adjectival |
| 3 | 75 | "bridal chamber" | "bridal chamber" | "wedding chamber" | *numfōn*: technical term preservation |

**Total disagreements: 3**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "standing" (literal), "the solitary ones" (preserves the *monachos* category), and "bridal chamber" (technical term).
